title: Premium Interface Stability
summary: YTIntel v0.18.1 fixes the browser-freezing observer loop from the first premium-interface release and forces clients onto the corrected shell.
discord_changes: Fixed the MutationObserver feedback loop that could make Chrome show Page Unresponsive on v0.18.0.
Forced a fresh v0.18.1 asset and service-worker cache so the broken shell is not reused.
Preserved the premium Smart Start, streamlined navigation, Intelligence Pulse, proof cards and upgraded Research Sprint visuals.
changes: Removed the self-triggering Updates-panel MutationObserver behaviour that repeatedly removed and re-added the current release class.
Changed release synchronization so it mutates the DOM only when the release state actually needs to change.
Reduced the Updates observer to child-list changes only instead of watching class attributes throughout the subtree.
Bumped all production asset references to v0.18.1 so the corrected shell bypasses the cached v0.18.0 JavaScript.
Changed the service worker to a new v0.18.1 cache and network-first delivery for core JavaScript/CSS assets during the hotfix transition.
Kept the full premium visual overhaul and existing research/intelligence behaviour intact.
why_it_matters: The first v0.18 visual release contained a UI synchronization bug that could trap the browser main thread in an observer feedback loop. v0.18.1 removes that loop and deliberately invalidates the affected cached assets so users can load the premium interface normally without losing the visual upgrade or research features.
